title: kate-core: keep a block comment inside a fold
summary: A line whose first text is /* is blank for indent folds. A hash line and a // line stay blank. The test goes in the existing fold tests module.

lane.reason: A local Qwen3.8 coder model with 27B parameters on the owner Mac codes this packet. The change is one file and stays under about 60 lines.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: fold.rs is a private module of view.rs. Its one test module is mod tests. Add the new test function at the end of that module, before its closing brace. Do not write a second mod tests. Change only the early if in line_indent. Keep let line = line.trim_end_matches('\r'); and let body = line.trim_start_matches([' ', '\t']);. The condition is one if: if body.starts_with('#') || body.starts_with("//") || body.starts_with("/*") { return LineIndent { blank: true, indent: 0 }; }. Use the array [' ', '\t']. Do not compare a character with a space or a tab by hand. Do not nest an if inside an if. Do not touch indent_folds, fold_at, leading_indent, innermost_fold, or span_contains_line. You may update a comment that lists only # and //. The existing tests a_hash_comment_does_not_end_a_fold and a_slash_comment_does_not_end_a_fold stay green. Do not rewrite their assertions. The test a_block_comment_does_not_end_a_fold calls indent_folds of a, newline, two spaces, /*, space, note, newline with tab width 4 and gets an empty vector. The same call on a, newline, two spaces, b, newline, /*, space, end, newline gets one FoldSpan with start 0 and end 4. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip. Keep the change under about 60 lines. Run the full test module named in the commands, not only the new test.

regression_tests.name: view::fold::tests::a_block_comment_does_not_end_a_fold
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main. A block comment under a starts a fold. After the change that text has no fold. A block line at column 0 no longer ends the fold of a and b.
